notes: Performance-first overnight envelope: per-cell winners may use different tactics and, where a format exposes them, different resident layouts.
Timing is the same-address warm ScaleFirst GEMM upper envelope; distinct MBU is a byte model, not a DRAM counter.
M=1 is dense decode; M=64 and M=2048 are the small/large prefill bands.
The selected full-attention layer and qtype come from the GGUF header; K and V remain separate tensor identities even though their geometry is equal.
For the controlled Q8_0 route the currently proved resident-layout domain contains A32/F1 only; absence of a second Q8 layout is reported rather than invented.
